assessments.reasoning: Section 6.1.6.2 defines BigInt’s value domain as integers and explicitly leaves their bit width unbounded. This is a property of the abstract type. Engine capacity and mixed-operand conversion fall outside the definition.

challenge.method: Check whether the two’s-complement model for binary operations introduces a fixed signed width.
challenge.results: The operational model extends negative values to the left indefinitely, consistent with the explicit width rule. No finite word size qualifies the type definition.

limitations: This does not set an engine's resource limits or imply that operations automatically coerce Number operands to BigInt.
A finite runtime experiment cannot establish the unbounded abstract specification or any implementation’s resource limit.
